**Remarks: -
East Malaysia (Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan or Malaysian Borneo) PLEASE SELECT SEA SHIPPING option

MAXIMUM PER ORDER: 20 BOTTLES ONLY
** IF ORDER MORE THAN 20 BOTTLES, PLEASE SEPARATE YOUR ORDER

Keep away from children

** STORAGE & HANDLING:
- Store in cool and dry place. Keep away from sunlight and heat.

**Remarks: -
East Malaysia (Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan or Malaysian Borneo) PLEASE SELECT SEA SHIPPING option

MAXIMUM PER ORDER: 20 BOTTLES ONLY
** IF ORDER MORE THAN 20 BOTTLES, PLEASE SEPARATE YOUR ORDER

1:10 (Light-duty)
1:3 (Heavy-duty)

- Highly concentrated and effective dirt remover.
- High alkaline based multiple application cleaner.
- Powerful chemical to remove stubborn dirt and grease easily.
- Low foam formulation suitable for the application using Auto-Scrubber.
- For best result, allow 3-5 minutes penetration before scrubbing.

SUITABLE USE FOR: -
- Ideal for most homogeneous tiles and exterior surfaces cleaning.

CAUTION:
- For external use only. Discontinue usage if skin irritation occurs. If conditions persist, please consult a doctor.
Keep away from children

** STORAGE & HANDLING:
- Store in cool and dry place. Keep away from sunlight and heat.
